author: Tucson AZ Daily Brief
title: 🏥 Tucson Healthcare Jobs: Multiple Local & Travel Roles Hiring Now - NewsBreak
text:
2 days ago Tucson’s healthcare scene is busy right now—lots of options whether you want steady local work or high‑pay travel contracts. Here are several solid picks you can scan and apply to fast.
Caregiver (Part-Time) Employer: Sevita / Mentor Community Services
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Part-time
Hands-on caregiving for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities in a community setting. Offers competitive pay, benefits for full-time roles , PTO, 401(k) with match, and strong training and support.
Caregiver (Full-Time) Employer: Sevita / Mentor Community Services
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
Similar role as above, but full-time so you can access the full benefits package and more job stability. Great fit if you’re patient, compassionate, and have a valid driver’s license.
PREOP PACU Registered Nurse Employer: United Surgical Partners International – Arizona Digestive Institute
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
PreOp/PACU RN for an outpatient GI surgery center. Provide pre-op, post-op, and sedation support with a Monday–Friday style surgery schedule and a full suite of medical, retirement, and paid holiday benefits.
Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Overnights) Employer: VEG ER for Pets
Location: Tucson/Oro Valley, AZ
Type: Full-time, nights
Overnight ER tech role in a 24/7 open-concept animal hospital handling true emergency cases . Credential required; offers day‑one health benefits, 401(k) match, CE/travel stipend, student loan help, and paid parental leave.
Travel Physical Therapist – ~$1,726/week Employer: Ardor Health Solutions
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 12 weeks, 40 hrs/week, days
Short‑term PT contract with nationwide agency support. Work 8‑hour day shifts with weekly pay and benefits , plus options to choose settings that match your goals.
Travel Nurse RN – Public Health – ~$2,741/week Employer: Prime Time Healthcare
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 40 hrs/week, days
Public Health RN assignment starting 10/19/2026 . Solid weekly pay, 8‑hour day shifts, and benefits including 401(k), HSA, and health/dental/vision .
Full-Time Hospice RN Case Manager Employer: AdvisaCare – Tucson Hospice
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
Field-based hospice RN role focused on end‑of‑life comfort and family support . Offers PTO, holidays, 401(k), medical benefits, mileage, and strong orientation and training.
Physical Therapist Assistant Employer: TMC: Therapy Management Corporation
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
PTA role serving adult/geriatric patients to improve mobility and independence . Includes flexible scheduling, generous PTO, 401(k) with match, CEU support, and potential tuition reimbursement.
Travel Physical Therapy Assistant – ~$1,344/week Employer: AHS Staffing
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 40 hrs/week, days
Travel PTA contract with guaranteed 40 hours and clear pay breakdown. Includes housing and M&I per diems , 401(k) match, and medical/dental/vision plus pet insurance.
Travel Physical Therapist – ~$2,092/week Employer: Ardor Health Solutions
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 12 weeks, 40 hrs/week, days
Another PT travel option starting 10/19/2026 with 8‑hour day shifts. Strong pay and benefits through a long‑standing therapy‑focused agency.
RN – Med Surg Tele (Travel) – ~$1,949/week Employer: Solomon Page
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: 13-week contract, 3×12 days
Med Surg Tele RN role with high stipends (~$1,229/week) and a 13‑week run. Comes with medical from day one, 401(k), ESOP, and other travel‑nurse perks.
Pharmacy Operations Manager Employer: Walgreens
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time
Pay: $22.50–$31.00/hour
Lead daily retail pharmacy operations as a full-time certified tech, including workflow, tech team supervision, and inventory. Includes Walgreens benefits, leadership duties, and flexible scheduling.
Medical Assistant – OBGYN Clinic Employer: Banner Health – Banner University Medical Center Tucson
Location: Tucson, AZ
Type: Full-time, Mon–Fri 8–5
Clinic MA role in an OB/GYN setting: room patients, help with procedures, handle paperwork and prior auths. No nights, weekends, or holidays and strong big-system benefits.
Travel OR RN – Operating Room – ~$2,493/week (Nights) Employer: Jackson Nurse Professionals
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 40 hrs/week, 10‑hr nights
High‑pay OR travel contract with a well‑known agency. Includes full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) match, same‑day pay access, and strong recruiter support.
Travel NICU RN – ~$2,459/week (Nights) Employer: Jackson Nurse Professionals
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 36 hrs/week, 12‑hr nights
NICU travel assignment in Tucson for experienced neonatal nurses. Solid weekly pay plus full benefits and certification reimbursement.
Travel NICU RN – ~$2,459/week (Days) Employer: Jackson Nurse Professionals
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 36 hrs/week, 12‑hr days
Same NICU specialty with a day shift option. Great if you want high acuity plus a daytime schedule.
Travel OR RN – Operating Room – ~$2,493/week (Nights) Employer: Jackson Nurse Professionals
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 40 hrs/week, 10‑hr nights
Another OR travel slot at similar pay—worth checking both listings for specific unit fit and start dates.
Travel Physical Therapist – ~$2,387/week Employer: Coast Medical Service
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, 13 weeks, 40 hrs/week, days
Day‑shift PT assignment with stipend guarantees for facility call‑offs , plus full travel‑nurse level benefits from a highly rated agency.
Travel Physical Therapist – ~$2,549/week Employer: Critical Connection, Inc.
Location: Tucson, AZ (Travel)
Type: Travel, full-time, 40 hrs/week, days
High‑pay PT contract with guaranteed hours (by assignment), CEU allowance, housing stipend, and first‑day insurance. Open to new grads and experienced PTs .
